multidimensional arrays, implicit zero tails and repeated constant data
4100 nonzero uints followed by 8192 explicit zeros, four nonzero suffix values and eight implicit zeros
8192-element sparse array; mutation across chunk boundary, skipped-zero region, suffix and final tail
global and local mutable independent copies, per-owner global and per-thread/per-owner TLS isolation, forced GC
pointer and struct relocation fallback values/identities

peProof.inspectedMethods: Every get___edg_initializer* method, including backing and reinterpreted view getters
requirements: only allow value-type ReadOnlySpan construction; reject heap constructors
only allow calls to another audited initializer getter, RuntimeHelpers.CreateSpan, MemoryMarshal.Cast or ReadOnlySpan constructor
every getter transitively references an actual FieldRVA data field
exact 32-byte reference uint initializer located in referenced RVA storage
peProof.limitation: This proves embedded constant storage and absence of heap-allocating operations in the initializer getters for these generated assemblies; it does not claim the entire translated program is allocation-free.
peProof.reflectionLocation: Standalone verification tool only; absent from generated library and JIT/NativeAOT host
